headline: Hamilton and Leclerc take 10-place grid penalties in Brazil
body: Both Ferrari drivers take a fifth internal combustion engine of the year at Interlagos, which triggers a 10-place grid drop for the race. Leclerc's engine change was confirmed during third practice.

headline: Verstappen and Perez start Brazil from the back after 30-place penalties
body: Verstappen takes a new engine, exhaust, turbocharger and power unit ancillary component, so he starts at the back of the grid wherever he qualifies. Perez takes a new engine, turbocharger and MGU-K and also drops 30 places.

headline: Formula 1 extends its Interlagos deal to 2035
body: Formula 1 has agreed to race in São Paulo until at least 2035, with the venue promising continued significant investment. Interlagos last extended its contract in 2023.
